development_gate: same economics with >=30 trades, positive on >=6/8 dates, and no unavailable accepted paths

event.entry_state: first completed residual contraction to 50% or less while remaining above 25%, followed by one completed second of original-direction follower aggressive flow

execution.source_boundary: accepted unresolved position pays full structural stop plus cost

label_and_route.positive: after fixed 100ms entry, 150% residual expansion is reached before 25% reclaim, adverse follower stop or BTC-origin failure
label_and_route.route: trade only when calibrated probability implies positive expected value after 24bp and exceeds the structure baseline probability by at least 0.05

model.baseline: structure-only logistic using gap, pullback depth, leader persistence and volatility
model.calibration: one frozen isotonic map fitted on calibration only when both classes are present

promotion_boundary: Any survivor remains pre-2024 discovery; exact Bybit BBO/depth, funding and full sequential 2024-2026 replay are required before ranking.
scientific_question: After BTC displacement and SOL/XRP beta-residual overdelivery accept external liquidity, can one explainable ML meta-label identify which first 50% residual pullbacks reaccelerate to 150% expansion before reclaim/BTC-origin failure strongly enough to survive 24bp and one-global-slot account replay?
smc_ict_translation: SOL or XRP extends beyond prior-only BTC beta fair value and accepts external liquidity, forming quantitative SMT overdelivery.
The first 50% residual pullback is a measurable FVG/OTE mitigation; it is the only admissible entry state.
One ML model accepts the trade only when pullback structure, flow, attention and leader persistence imply renewed distribution in the original direction.
Target is 150% residual expansion; invalidation is 25% residual reclaim, adverse follower displacement, BTC-origin failure or conservative source-boundary stop.
ML cannot choose direction, entry depth, target, stop, latency, risk or leverage.
